education_history.institution: Hanoi University of Science and Technology (HUST)

projects.description: Designed and implemented a production-style multi-agent RAG system using Lang Graph with Planner-Executor-Verifier architecture for complex question answering. Built hybrid retrieval pipeline combining dense embeddings, BM25, and cross-encoder re-ranking to improve retrieval quality and reduce hallucinations. Developed specialized agents (Planner, Retriever, Executor, Critic/Verifier) with conditional routing, self-correction loops, and tool calling (SQL + external APIs). Containerized the entire system with Docker and docker-compose; added Fast API endpoints, structured logging, and basic evaluation pipeline for continuous quality monitoring.
projects.name: Multi-Agent Agentic RAG System

projects.description: Collected and processed the Vi Lex Norm dataset alongside ~18.6K real Threads comments to train an NLP system translating Gen Z teencode slang to standard Vietnamese. Fine-tuned BARTpho in two phases—full fine-tuning then hard-example refinement—using loss-based noise filtering, mixed-precision (fp16), and Adam W. Designed an evaluation benchmark (Exact Match, BLEU, WER, CER, latency/throughput) on a curated golden test set; Phase-2 model achieved ~76% corpus BLEU and ~87% word accuracy.
projects.name: Teen Code Translator

parsed_data.summary: An eager student at HUST with major interest in Large Language Models (LLMs), and multi-agent systems, RAG. Ready to take part in either production or researching workflows.
